topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Opening the door, there they were—vibrant blooms, a burst of color against the gray of the day, nestled in a vibrant vase. The delivery person just winked and left, no card in sight. I can’t help but twirl a petal between my fingers, imagining the thought behind this mystery. A secret admirer? An old friend saying hello without words? The possibilities dance around my mind, each one more delightful than the last. I find myself arranging the flowers, picking out the perfect spot where they’ll brighten the room, and maybe, just maybe, someone’s day.
